title: Mortar round wounds Thai soldier; Cambodia calls it operational error
detail: Thailand's army said a mortar round fired from the Cambodian side wounded one Thai soldier in Ubon Ratchathani, calling it a breach of the 27 Dec ceasefire; the Thai military said Cambodia described it as an unintentional operational error.
attribution: Thai army claims, Cambodian explanation as relayed by Thai military, via Al Jazeera

title: National Bank places Prince Bank into liquidation
detail: The NBC suspended all new services at Prince Bank and appointed a liquidator two days after Prince Group chairman Chen Zhi was extradited to China; the bank had been sanctioned by the US and UK in Oct 2025.

title: Over 10,000 displaced still barred from homes along Thai border
detail: Provincial officials said about 9,000 people (2,735 families) in Banteay Meanchey plus families in Pursat, Preah Vihear and Oddar Meanchey could not return home despite the ceasefire; over 173,000 remained in camps. Thailand denies territorial expansion.

title: First human H5N1 case of 2026 in Kampot
detail: The Ministry of Health confirmed H5N1 in a 30-year-old man from Tuek Chhou district, Kampot, who had cooked dead chickens at home; he recovered and was discharged, and contacts received Tamiflu.

title: Hun Manet says Thai forces occupy territory deep inside Cambodia
detail: PM Hun Manet claimed Thai troops placed containers and barbed wire in Cambodian areas of Pursat and Banteay Meanchey, keeping about 80,000 people from home; Thailand has previously said it only holds Thai territory.
attribution: Hun Manet claims via Al Jazeera

title: Night blaze kills four in Russei Keo
detail: A fire in Boeung Salang village destroyed three flats, killing four and injuring five; the Phnom Penh fire department deployed 22 water tenders and said the cause was under investigation.

title: Thai navy seizes Cambodian fishing boat near Koh Yor; MFA protests
detail: Cambodia's foreign ministry said the Thai navy arrested three Cambodians and seized a fishing boat about 7.2 nm from Koh Yor, Koh Kong, calling it a violation of Cambodian territorial sea; Thailand says the boat was in Thai waters.
agency: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
attribution: Cambodian MFA claims via CamboJA News

title: Middle East conflict disrupts Gulf-linked flights to Cambodia
detail: The State Secretariat of Civil Aviation said 52 weekly Middle East-linked flights (46 via Techo International, 6 via Siem Reap-Angkor) were affected by airspace closures after strikes on Iran from 28 Feb, with up to 12,960 passengers a week at risk.

title: Rain floods border displacement camp in Thmar Pouk
detail: Heavy rain flooded the Wat Kandol pagoda camp sheltering about 1,631 displaced families in Thmar Pouk district; about 400 families moved to higher ground, a district deputy governor said.
attribution: District officials and residents via CamboJA News

title: 77 foreigners detained at Ream online-fraud site
detail: Provincial police led by a deputy governor raided the Silong Bay Borey site in Sangkat Ream, detaining 77 foreigners and seizing 77 computers and phones.

title: Fourth human H5N1 case of 2026 confirmed in Svay Rieng
detail: The Ministry of Health confirmed H5N1 in a 66-year-old woman in Svay Rieng who had contact with infected poultry at home, the fourth human case of 2026; Institut Pasteur researchers have flagged a novel reassortant strain.
agency: Ministry of Health / Institut Pasteur du Cambodge

title: EDC deploys temporary substations as energy crisis strains grid
detail: Électricité du Cambodge deployed two 75 MW temporary modular substations on the 230 kV network at Veal Rinh (Preah Sihanouk) and Samrong Yong (Takeo), and the National Assembly is reviewing a law guaranteeing payments for Vietnamese power imports to 2030.
place: Veal Rinh and Samrong Yong substations

title: Defence minister welcomes plan for General Border Committee meeting
detail: Deputy PM and Defence Minister Tea Seiha welcomed a Thai suggestion for a GBC meeting, the first since 27 Dec 2025; Thailand's defence minister said reopening checkpoints would be the final step. About 32,000 Cambodians remained displaced.
attribution: Defence ministers' statements via The Star/ANN

title: Two worker-transport crashes kill 14 garment workers
detail: A cargo truck hit an open-top worker transport in Kampong Chhnang (9 dead, 53 injured) and a bus carrying workers overturned in Svay Rieng (5 dead, 40 injured); the Labour Ministry urged stricter traffic compliance.
agency: Ministry of Labour and Vocational Training

title: 64 Chinese nationals arrested at Sihanoukville casino scam site
detail: Preah Sihanouk authorities and prosecutors raided the Ying Huang casino in Sangkat 4, arresting 64 Chinese nationals and seizing 428 phones and 37 computers.

title: Single lightning strike kills three rice farmers in Pursat
detail: Local police said lightning killed three farmers sowing rice in Meteuk commune, Bakan district, on the afternoon of 28 May; the same day lightning killed 19 cattle in Lumphat, Ratanakiri.

title: 111 detained, 108 Indonesians, in Sihanoukville scam raid
detail: The Sihanoukville unified command and provincial prosecutor detained 111 people in Sangkat 4, including 108 Indonesians (37 women) processed for deportation, and seized 117 laptops and 415 phones.

title: OFAC expands Prince Group sanctions; FinCEN widens Huione rule
detail: OFAC designated 9 individuals and 26 entities linked to Prince Group, including second-in-command Hu Xiaowei and companies in the UK, BVI, Hong Kong and Singapore; FinCEN proposed extending its Huione Group rule to H-Pay Service PLC and successors.
attribution: OFAC/FinCEN actions summarised by HSF Kramer

title: CDC: Cambodia had 4 human H5N1 cases and 1 death in H1 2026
detail: The US CDC global summary counted four human H5N1 cases in Cambodia from January to June 2026 (onsets in February, March and April), one fatal, all linked to sick or dead backyard poultry and clade 2.3.2.1e viruses.

title: Landmine/UXO casualties reach 28 in first half of 2026
detail: CMAA said mines and explosive remnants of war caused 28 casualties in H1 2026 (7 killed, 15 injured, 6 amputees), up 16.6% from 24 a year earlier.
agency: Cambodian Mine Action and Victim Assistance Authority (CMAA)

title: NCDM: lightning killed 16 in H1 2026, down 48% on 2025
detail: The National Committee for Disaster Management reported 16 lightning deaths and 18 injuries in the first half of 2026 (31 deaths a year earlier), plus 3 deaths and 9 injuries from other storm impacts.

title: Fifth human H5N1 case of 2026: infant in Phnom Penh
detail: The Ministry of Health confirmed H5N1 in a nine-month-old girl in Meanchey district, Phnom Penh, who was in intensive care; it was the country's fifth human case of 2026.

title: Immigration says 16,000 foreigners deported for scam involvement in H1
detail: General Department of Immigration chief Lt Gen Sok Veasna said 16,000 foreigners were deported for involvement in scam compounds in the first half of 2026, out of 45,000 deportations overall; about 2,000 people were refused entry.
attribution: Immigration department figures via AGB/Khmer Times

title: Battery recycling site fire spews toxic smoke in Kampong Speu
detail: A fire and explosions at an unpermitted lithium battery and metal recycling site in Samaki Mony Chey district produced toxic smoke into 30 Jul, killing about 2,000 chickens at a nearby farm; the Ministry of Environment ordered penalties and health officials urged residents to wear masks.
place: Tuol Sambour village, Damnak Raing commune
attribution: Ministry of Environment findings via The Star/ANN

title: EU sanctions Prince Holding Group, Chen Zhi and Jin Bei Group
detail: The EU listed Prince Holding Group, its chairman Chen Zhi, Sihanoukville-based Jin Bei Group and its chairman Zhu Zhongbiao under its global human-rights sanctions regime, citing at least 10 forced-labour scam compounds in Cambodia; asset freezes and travel bans apply.

title: Road deaths up 11% to 773 in H1 after enforcement pause
detail: Interior Minister Sar Sokha told the PM that H1 2026 saw 1,279 crashes, 773 deaths and 1,944 injuries, up from 694 deaths a year earlier, blaming a pause in traffic-law enforcement; he sought to resume strict enforcement from 1 Sep.

title: NCDM and water ministry order flood preparedness as rivers rise
detail: NCDM issued a directive and the Ministry of Water Resources and Meteorology an advisory on 19 Aug warning of rising Mekong, Bassac and Tonle Sap levels and heavy rain from storm Saudel through 29 Aug, with coastal seas of 0.5-1.75 m.
agency: National Committee for Disaster Management; Ministry of Water Resources and Meteorology
attribution: NCDM and MOWRAM warnings via Cambodianess

title: 35 foreigners detained in Sihanoukville hotel scam raid
detail: Provincial gendarmerie under the unified command raided the 22-storey Chun Yi Hotel in Sangkat 3, detaining 35 foreigners including four women and seizing computers and 55 phones linked to fraud.

title: Mekong floods affect 13,688 families after Typhoon Saudel
detail: NCDM said Mekong flooding that began around 22-23 Aug affected 13,688 families in Kratie, Tboung Khmum, Stung Treng and Kampong Cham, with 1,551 families evacuated, over 9,000 homes inundated and over 4,000 ha of rice submerged; no casualties reported.

title: Anti-scam commission claims Cambodia has no remaining scam compounds
detail: CCOS, headed by Senior Minister Chhay Sinarith, claimed that from July 2025 to 20 Aug 2026 it investigated 793 suspected sites, raided 624, detained nearly 30,000 people of 39 nationalities and deported 58,266 foreigners; anti-trafficking experts disputed the claim that scam operations were eradicated.

title: 19,652 drug suspects held, 2.65 t narcotics seized Jan-Aug
detail: Cambodian authorities reported 7,347 drug cases and 19,652 suspects detained in Jan-Aug 2026, with 2.65 t of narcotics, 282 kg of marijuana and 2.26 t of precursor chemicals seized.
